runs.description: Invocations the plugin infers, each a program and its arguments

applications.description: Application bundles the invocations install, a running one named in the last line as needing a relaunch

profiles.description: Patterns of the profiles the invocations write, each match removed before the invocations

objects.description: Instrumented binaries llvm-cov reads the coverage mapping of

file.description: File the lcov report is written to

report.description: lcov report written once every invocation passes: the profiles matching profiles merge with xcrun llvm-profdata merge, then export over objects with xcrun llvm-cov export

dryRun.description: Prints each invocation and runs none

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

outputs.description: Files the configuration writes, which the target's outputs name through {options.outputs.<n>}

title: Run
description: Runs swift and xcodebuild invocations in order with Nx's per-task environment removed and git status.branch off after the caller's GIT_CONFIG_<n> entries, stopping at the first failure, then writes the lcov report a coverage configuration states
